```json
{
  "winner": "A",
  "reasons": [
    "A's market shows that buyers already pay for this narrow feature. Several sourced competitors charge per agent: Blitzz from about $15-19/mo per agent rising to $25-45/mo, and CrankWheel Solo at $29/mo. A gap exists between free tools and enterprise suites, and a small-team self-serve wedge priced near those anchors is plausible.",
    "B faces a sourced $0 anchor from an incumbent with built-in distribution: Slack Code, bundled into every Slack plan. B also has at least five direct competitors that launched in the same window, including a free open-source option. A's free alternatives (Quick Assist, JoinByKey) are general-purpose or minimal, and A's own brief cites a complaint that Quick Assist is unreliable.",
    "B's brief marks two of its load-bearing claims as unsourced, and they count as missing. One is that the product can be built solo in six weeks. The other is that demand exists beyond engineering. Without the second, B's stated multi-team audience shrinks to engineering only, which is the most crowded slice.",
    "Acquisition looks cheaper for A. A's sourced cross-industry average CPC is $4.66. B's sourced figures are a B2B SaaS CPC of about $8.86 and a devtools cost of about $650 per SQL, which is harder for a 90-day first-customer target."
  ],
  "weakest_evidence_in_loser": "B's strongest demand signal in its Case For is a 'dedicated YC Fall 2026 RFS on the topic', which has no citation, so it counts as missing. Behind it are two quotes. One is an unnamed operations lead quoted on a company blog. The other is a single dev.to post. Neither shows anyone willing to pay for a standalone multiplayer layer rather than bundled features.",
  "confidence_note": "Moderate-low confidence. A has a real weakness: all three demand quotes come from individuals helping elderly family members, not support-team buyers. That leaves the B2B payer unvalidated, and compliance gates (SOC 2, HIPAA) could stall first deals. A wins mainly because B's competitive position, with a free incumbent bundle and a land-grab, looks worse, not because A's evidence is strong."
}
```
